At a technical level, these tools use generative AI (typically diffusion models) to put garments onto AI-generated humans. An AI model swap tool uses advanced machine learning algorithms to isolate a garment from an original image, such as a ghost mannequin or a flat lay, and digitally wrap that garment onto a photorealistic AI-generated human model. The software preserves the exact texture, color, logos, and draping of the original clothing while generating realistic lighting and shadows.

1. **Upload existing imagery.** You upload your standard flat-lay or model photos.
